title: Rappler Recap: PH ends ASEAN chairship with gains, but Myanmar and COC unresolved
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has some new landmark agreements to tout, but the Myanmar crisis and the proposed Code of Conduct in the South China Sea remain unresolved

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippines’ turn to lead the Association of Southeast Asian Nations ends as the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits officially closes.
President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has some new landmark agreements to tout, but the Myanmar crisis and the proposed Code of Conduct or COC in the South China Sea remain unresolved.
Rappler’s Lance Spencer Yu takes you through the final day of the summit. – Rappler.com
